metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the strict LAS 1.4 inspector/renderer at [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py).

It supports LAS 1.4 headers, VLRs/EVLRs, CRS records, point formats 0–10, waveform metadata/data, extra bytes, validation errors, and the requested JSON CLI interface. I also verified render→inspect round trips across all point formats and key metadata paths.

editorial.last_message: Completed the Python LAS implementation; unchanged source passes all 223 tests under LAS 2.0.4.
editorial.notes:

The new negative declares external waveform storage while retaining internal packet data and keeps the internal bit clear; it does not duplicate the both-bits-set check. Acceptance/rejection solely for a clear deprecated internal bit remains unscored.  No remaining failed cases were observed. Full original transcript/source reviews are carried forward with their reviewer, content hash and path below. Those earlier reviews are historical evidence; their former tool-count exactness claims are superseded by the current session-based audit. Audited v2 tool calls: 70; preserved original recorded count: 69. The difference is a proven attempted tool request rejected before any canonical item; this does not change the counting definition. Input, output, cache and reasoning totals reparse exactly and remain complete; all token/cost fields and generation metadata are preserved. Regrading adds no model calls or generation cost. Original result/source/session/raw reports and previous regrade history remain unchanged. Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.
